snippet.title: Hunters of Faenora - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: 2TG Entertainment is thrilled to announce To The Grave: The Hunters of Faenora! A roguelite tactics RPG with permadeathly high stakes coming soon to a browser near you! All footage in game is from the Hunters of Faenora alpha demo - closed alpha access will be revealed soon, so make sure to follow @FaenoraVerse on Twitter!
